# Marvel Labs

> Marvel Labs makes the autonomous microfactory trailer: an equipment trailer for landscaping crews with a 6 ft enclosed factory at the front that turns bagged grass clippings into boxed sinks. Concept in development; Spring 2027 delivery target.

Key facts (from the live site, November 2026):
- Who it's for: landscaping crews and lawn-care operators who already mow and bag clippings.
- How it works: tip bagged clippings into the hopper; the enclosed factory makes and boxes a sink while you work; drop the boxed sink at The UPS Store on your route; the Marvel Crew app confirms the hand-off.
- Sizes: 16 ft (7 ft wide, 10 ft rear cargo) and 20 ft (8.5 ft wide, 14 ft rear cargo); both carry the same 6 ft enclosed factory.
- Preview pricing: Buy 16 ft $44,999 or 20 ft $49,999.99 with a 75% operator profit share; Lease with a 25% operator profit share (lease terms in a separate agreement).
- Profit share = the operator's share of profit on sinks sold. The $300/day figure (20 sinks × $15) is an illustration, not a projection; earnings are not guaranteed.
- Reservation: $100 deposit, fully refundable, no cancellation fee, credited toward the final price. The reservation flow on the current site is a demo and takes no payment.
- Delivery: Spring 2027 target, not guaranteed; limited availability.
- Contact: hello@marvellabs.com
